answer: One workable design: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because inlet only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, voyage is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any forge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
